title: Subprocess Pipe Buffer Exhaustion on Long Transcodes
symptom: FFmpeg child process hangs indefinitely after processing large ProRes batch

hypotheses.claim: Stdio pipe buffer exhaustion blocks child process write
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Drain stderr in concurrent thread vs synchronous wait
Monitor lsof fd limits during batch execution

evidence.note: FFmpeg process hangs when stderr exceeds 64KB buffer on macOS; reading stderr continuously resolves hang
